description: A mosquito-borne viral disease that causes a severe flu-like illness.
causes: Dengue virus transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes.
prevention: Prevent mosquito bites and eliminate breeding sites.
treatment_action: Fluids, rest, and pain relievers (avoid aspirin).
complications: Dengue hemorrhagic fever and shock syndrome.

description: A chronic condition in which the pancreas produces little or no insulin.
causes: Autoimmune reaction where the body attacks insulin-producing cells.
prevention: No known way to prevent Type 1 diabetes.
treatment_action: Insulin therapy and regular blood sugar monitoring.
complications: Heart disease, nerve damage, kidney damage, and vision loss.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A chronic condition that affects the way the body processes blood sugar (glucose).
causes: Insulin resistance or insufficient insulin production, often linked to weight and inactivity.
prevention: Healthy diet, regular exercise, and weight management.
treatment_action: Lifestyle changes, oral medications, and sometimes insulin.
complications: Heart disease, stroke, kidney failure, and foot problems.

description: A genetic disorder caused when abnormal cell division results in an extra full or partial copy of chromosome 21.
prevention: No known way to prevent, but prenatal screening is available.
treatment_action: Early intervention programs, speech therapy, and physical therapy.
complications: Heart defects, gastrointestinal defects, and sleep apnea.

description: A movement disorder in which your muscles contract involuntarily, causing repetitive or twisting movements.
causes: Altered nerve cell communication in several areas of the brain.
prevention: No known way to prevent dystonia.
treatment_action: Botox injections, medications, and physical therapy.
complications: Physical disabilities, vision problems, and depression.
